_note: RULES569 R5c: R5 with one change - a clinch does not end the exchange (N.dearClinch 1): the referee breaks the men at Mid, still in range, so the count is kept (not raised). Only a beat with no punch outside a clinch, or a back off, resets. Tried because the feint-then-overhand loop alternates punch beat / clinch beat, so under R5 it never pays the surcharge.
